Untitled draft
Unavailable or incomplete draft
Open this local draft? Your unsaved form edits will be discarded. The selected saved copy will be read from disk; unavailable data will not be reset.
Create and open a new empty local draft? Your current unsaved form edits will be discarded only after successful creation. Existing saved drafts remain unchanged.

Duplicate the current saved snapshot into a new local draft? Pending form edits are not included and will be discarded only after successful creation. Saved content and pins are copied; prior history is not copied. The original draft stays unchanged.

New draft could not be created. Your current form is retained. The library has a 64-draft limit including pending cleanup. Refresh the local list before retrying; delete unneeded drafts explicitly to make room.

Creation could not be confirmed for local ID %1$s. Your current form is retained. A new directory or saved copy may exist. Refresh Manage local drafts and inspect that ID before creating another copy.
The selected draft could not be opened. Your original draft identity, pending edits and save state are retained. A newly created draft remains in the local list for inspection.
Local ID: %1$s
Delete local draft
Retry local cleanup
Deletion started; cleanup needs review

Permanently delete local ID %1$s, its retained revisions and its cached revision files? This cannot be undone. Other drafts stay available. If this is the current draft, the visible unsaved form will remain, but saving to this deleted ID will be disabled. Interrupted cleanup must be retried from Manage local drafts.
The selected local draft and its retained revision files have been removed. Other drafts remain available. This is local file removal, not a claim of secure erasure from the device.

This local draft was deleted or cleanup started. Your visible unsaved form remains, but saving to this ID is disabled. Manage local drafts to inspect cleanup or explicitly open or create another draft.
The selected saved draft changed after this list was read. Nothing was deleted. Refresh Manage local drafts and review the current record before deleting.
Deletion could not start. The current form is retained. Refresh Manage local drafts and retry after the storage problem is resolved.

Deletion could not be fully confirmed. Some local files may remain. Use Retry local cleanup to reconcile the same ID, even if its row is already absent from Manage local drafts. Your visible unsaved form remains.
Save pending edits as a new local draft
Create recovery copy

Create a separate local draft using the visible title, sample selection, objective, context and workload inputs? Other domain settings and metadata come from the loaded baseline revision %1$s. Newer changes to the original are not merged. The original draft and its history stay unchanged. The copy starts its own history and does not carry evaluation or pricing acceptance. If creation is unconfirmed, inspect the reported local ID before trying again.
Local cleanup for ID %1$s is still unconfirmed. Reconcile that operation before starting another deletion.

Reconcile the previously requested local deletion of ID %1$s? Remaining cleanup will be retried, including when the row has already disappeared. A still-active row without a deletion marker will require fresh inspection and confirmation. Visible unsaved fields remain, and this does not remove external or remote copies.
Local cleanup could not be confirmed. The pending ID is retained; use Retry local cleanup again after the storage condition is resolved.
